CustomObject.description: One tier row in a tiered/volume-based fee structure. Master-detail child of Fee_Structures__c. Multiple tiers per Fee_Structure define a band-based fee schedule (e.g. 0.50% at 0-50% utilisation, 0.25% at 50-75%, 0.00% at 75-100%). TieredFeeResolver selects the applicable tier at fee period close. Spec v7 Part 5.2.9.
CustomObject.label: Fee Tier
